The '''Cavern of Broken Dreams''' was a point of interest on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].

The young [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] warrior apprentice, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], went to the cavern out of depression for having failed his first warrior's test. His friend, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], attempted to force a mischievous [[Lucksprite/Legends|Lucksprite]] to tell Wicket the truth: that he was the one responsible for Wicket's failure.

Wicket initially refused to believe Kneesaa, even after he saved her from a [[Unidentified Endor arachnid|giant spider]] and defeated the Lucksprite's bad luck. However, upon learning that he was the first warrior to ever defeat this particularly formidable Lucksprite, Wicket eagerly accepted Kneesaa's intercession for a new test, and left the cavern.
